name: sarama-protocol-response-health-ledger-and-1589
instr:
Sarama cannot share inspectable, broker-local health evidence across Kafka exchanges. Build a common account for metadata, produce, SASL handshake, authentication, producer, and administrative behavior so unhealthy brokers are avoided and recover safely without changing healthy-broker semantics.

Responses produce deterministic, API-appropriate evidence: fatal outranks retryable, then healthy. Metadata retains mixed topology outcomes; produce retains ordered partition and available leader evidence; SASL is connection-only and error-driven. Record one terminal observation per completed response-bearing exchange, including asynchronous, authentication, decoding, and transport failures, in a bounded, completion-ordered ledger with unique monotonic sequences.

Consecutive policy failures open the circuit. One admitted probe decides recovery; stale or unrelated success cannot reset newer state. Reject before writing request bytes with `ResponseHealthAdmissionError` containing `BrokerID`, `APIKey`, `Snapshot`, and `Cause`; `Error` and `Unwrap` preserve normal error handling. Disabled enforcement still records snapshots but never rejects an otherwise valid request.

Client metadata, leader, coordinator, general broker, and substitutable administrative selection avoid open circuits when an eligible alternative exists and allow one controlled probe otherwise. Controller-bound administration preserves typed rejection and Kafka topology. Reroute producer work without changing partition
